parsed.summary: The PR adds a new hook `get_inlines` to `ModelAdmin` to allow dynamic inlines based on the request or model instance. The change is minimal and well-tested.

issues.description: The new method `get_inlines` is added, but it does not follow the naming convention of other similar methods in `ModelAdmin` (e.g., `get_fields`, `get_readonly_fields`). It might be more consistent to name it `get_inline_classes`.
